method: Monthly MODIS 500 m Burn_Date COG clipped to RFO pixel centers. Burned pixels have Burn_Date 1-366 and QA land and valid-data bits both set; area is burned-pixel count times equal-area sinusoidal grid-cell area. No extrapolation. This is a coarse satellite burned-area estimate, not burned biomass or emissions.
